messages:
Maya - Partnerships: Heads-up 11  HelixEdge (hardware + SI) wants a marketplace onramp for ap-south-2. Theyre shipping an appliance-backed SKU and want a joint GTM with a 30-day trial credit + managed onboarding. Need quota, SKU, PCI/KMS notes, and SI runbook by end of month.

Dan - HelixEdge (SI): Were ready to support initial customers. Appliance specs: 4 x A10G-e (custom), NVLink disabled. Requesting 4 reserved nodes + burst 8. Trial: 1000 free inference minutes.

Leo - Eng Infra: Quick Q  are customers expected to use Private or Dedicated? That affects provisioning and marketplace flow.

Dan - HelixEdge (SI): Primary flow: Dedicated via marketplace. We also want a Private toggle for enterprise SIs that onboard appliances on-prem.

Priya - Product: Product note: Marketplace listing must call out "appliance-backed dedicated SKU" and allow model pinning. Also need to expose a fallback policy to smaller quantized variants.

Maya - Partnerships: Timeline: partner requests soft-launch 2026-05-10; internal deadline for entitlements + legal = 2026-04-28.

Ava - Legal: Two items: 1) trial credit T&Cs (refunds/abuse) 2) KMS cross-account wrap rules for HelixEdge-managed keys. I'll draft language. Need partner sign-off by 2026-04-25.

Leo - Eng Infra: Opening quota ticket and marketplace registration. Tagging infra-bot.

infra-bot: Ticket created: Q-55988. Marketplace registration: MR-88120.

marketplace-bot: MR-88120 status: metadata_required -> action_required (publishing team). Required fields: sku_id, short_description, private_toggle_flag, kms_scope.

Maya - Partnerships: Action items: 1) HelixEdge to provide final SKU name + trial text by 4/18; 2) Legal (Ava) to send draft trial T&Cs 4/20; 3) Eng Infra (Leo) to get quota approval 4/22; 4) Product (Priya) to confirm fallback policies 4/22; 5) SI runbook draft 4/24.

Dan - HelixEdge (SI): Sending SKU proposals: `helixedge-ap2-a10g-x4` and `helixedge-ap2-a10g-x4-managed`. Trial text attached in DM.

Leo - Eng Infra: Quota snippet submitted: ```region: ap-south-2
sku: helixedge-ap2-a10g-x4
requested: 4
burst: 8
purpose: partner launch + 30 day trial
```

infra-bot: Q-55988 status: PENDING_REVIEW. Estimated reviewer ETA: 36h.

Ava - Legal: Draft T&Cs posted to the thread (short): "Trial credits limited to first-time customers, abuse may result in suspension. HelixEdge and Redwood jointly may revoke credits for misuse. Data residency: customers elect region; do not claim cross-border guarantees." Please review.

Maya - Partnerships: Small ask for comms  partner wants us to include HelixEdge logo + a partner quote in the listing. Ensure logo asset rights cleared.

Ava - Legal: We need a signed logo usage form + approved quote. I'll circulate a one-click approval link.

Priya - Product: Verified fallback policy works; adding a config flag `fallback_to_quant_v2` to the SKU. Will add to listing metadata.

Dan - HelixEdge (SI): Confirming logo and quote will be returned by 4/20. Also asking if we can pre-seed two customer pilots (internal sales accounts) for smoke tests the week before launch.

Leo - Eng Infra: If quota approves, provision window looks like 2026-05-03 to 2026-05-05 for the reserved nodes. We can do pilot access earlier in a test pool if partner signs ATO for test service account.

infra-bot: Q-55988 status: PENDING_REVIEW -> APPROVED (provisional). Provision window: 2026-05-03 - 2026-05-05.

marketplace-bot: MR-88120 status: action_required -> metadata_complete. Next: security review.

Ava - Legal: Logo usage signed. Trial T&Cs approved by HelixEdge. I'll upload executed doc.

Maya - Partnerships: Great. Remaining blockers?

Priya - Product: One small item  ensure streaming endpoint supports appliance client handshake (we patched earlier, all good). I'll push the listing PR once marketplace team signals publish window.

Dan - HelixEdge (SI): We're ready for pilots. Please provide test service account and contact for onboarding.

Leo - Eng Infra: DM sent with service account (marketplace-service@redwood) and required scopes: `marketplace:publish`, `kms:wrap`, `dedicated:provision`. Also shared onboarding checklist.

Maya - Partnerships: Final note  embargo? Partner prefers soft-launch to early customers 05/10 and public announcement 05/24. They want a 1-week pre-brief for enterprise accounts. I'll note in release doc.

Ava - Legal: Adding embargo clause to release checklist.

Maya - Partnerships: Thanks team. Weekly check Friday 09:00 UTC. If anything blocks, flag me directly. :rocket:

marketplace-bot: MR-88120 status: security_review -> APPROVED. Publish window requested: 2026-05-06 to 2026-05-08.

Maya - Partnerships: Publishing window looks good. I'll coordinate with partner and comms for pilot invites.

Leo - Eng Infra: Final ops note  monitor for NVLink mismatch errors in ap-south-2; we had a similar issue in eu-west-2 last quarter. Will run a preflight.

Maya - Partnerships: closing thread  keep replies short here, escalate long threads to 1:1. Thanks everyone!"
